invariants.rationale: This invariant reflects the possible case that the input parameter is null, which may be valid at method entry.
This invariant expresses that the input parameter might be non-null when the method is called.
The length of a CharSequence is always non-negative; the null case is guarded for safety.
Calling toString() on a non-null CharSequence should never return null.
If text is not null, its length cannot be negative (defensive formulation).
